mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, interest_type, interest_key, interest_score, behavior_count, update_time, create_time FROM user_interest_tag WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY interest_score DESC
SELECT id, user_id, interest_type, interest_key, interest_score, behavior_count, update_time, create_time FROM user_interest_tag WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY interest_score DESC

SELECT id, user_id, interest_type, interest_key, interest_score, behavior_count, update_time, create_time FROM user_interest_tag WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND interest_score > 0.1 ORDER BY interest_score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_interest_tag ( user_id, interest_type, interest_key, interest_score, behavior_count, update_time, create_time ) VALUES ( #{userInterest.userId}, #{userInterest.interestType}, #{userInterest.interestKey}, #{userInterest.interestScore}, #{userInterest.behaviorCount}, #{userInterest.updateTime}, #{userInterest.createTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE interest_score = VALUES(interest_score), behavior_count = VALUES(behavior_count), update_time = VALUES(update_time)

INSERT INTO user_interest_tag ( user_id, interest_type, interest_key, interest_score, behavior_count, update_time, create_time ) VALUES
(#{interest.userId}, #{interest.interestType}, #{interest.interestKey}, #{interest.interestScore}, #{interest.behaviorCount}, #{interest.updateTime}, #{interest.createTime})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE interest_score = VALUES(interest_score), behavior_count = VALUES(behavior_count), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.update: UPDATE user_interest_tag SET interest_score = interest_score * #{decayFactor}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND interest_score > 0.01
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_interests, SUM(interest_score) as total_score, AVG(interest_score) as avg_score, MAX(interest_score) as max_score, MIN(interest_score) as min_score, SUM(behavior_count) as total_behaviors FROM user_interest_tag WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT uit2.user_id FROM user_interest_tag uit1 INNER JOIN user_interest_tag uit2 ON uit1.interest_type = uit2.interest_type AND uit1.interest_key = uit2.interest_key AND uit1.user_id != uit2.user_id WHERE uit1.user_id = #{userId} AND uit1.interest_type = 'TAG' AND uit2.interest_type = 'TAG' AND uit1.interest_score > 1.0 AND uit2.interest_score > 1.0 GROUP BY uit2.user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SUM(uit2.interest_score) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_interest_tag WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND update_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND interest_score < 0.5
mapper.select: SELECT b.id as bookId, b.title as bookTitle, b.author as author, b.cover_url as bookCover, b.category_id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, b.average_score as averageScore, b.score_count as scoreCount, b.favorite_count as favoriteCount, b.hot_score as hotScore, b.create_time as createTime FROM book b INNER JOIN book_tag_relation btr ON b.id = btr.book_id INNER JOIN tag t ON btr.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE t.name = #{tagName} ORDER BY COALESCE(b.hot_score, 0) DESC, COALESCE(b.favorite_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(b.average_score, 0) DESC, b.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_interest_tag WHERE interest_score > 0.1 ORDER BY user_id
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_interest_tag WHERE interest_type = 'TAG' AND interest_key = #{tagName} AND interest_score > 0.1 ORDER BY interest_score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
